parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of steel, providing structural support and rigidity to the appliance.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire refrigerator structure, holding the body interior and door in place while maintaining shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed component and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Body Interior
parts.Basic_description: The body interior of the refrigerator is made of ABS plastic, forming the inner compartment where food and beverages are stored.
parts.Functional_description: It provides insulation and houses shelves and compartments for organized storage while maintaining a hygienic and easy-to-clean surface.
parts.Movement_description: The body interior is stationary and does not move, but it interacts with removable shelves and drawers.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The refrigerator door is made of steel, often with an insulated core, and serves as the main access point to the interior.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the refrigerator to maintain internal temperature, preventing heat exchange and ensuring energy efficiency. It also holds shelves for additional storage.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges, allowing it to open and close smoothly for user access.
